AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
